name: print-social-car-sharing-posts-cream-blue-notebook-grid-doodles
title: Car sharing pack on a notebook-grid cream background with cobalt blue swoosh shapes and hand-drawn cars
whatItIs: Nine square posts on a faint graph-paper grid, with a big blue swoosh ribbon shape, hand-drawn line-art cars, gear icons, a vertical 'Car Sharing' rotated tag with a car icon, bold headlines ('Car Sharing To Cut Gas Emissions In Half!', 'Top 5 Benefits Of Car Sharing') and a 'Know More' arrow link.
whatItMeans: Casual and approachable; the notebook grid and doodle cars make an eco-transport pitch feel like a friendly sketch rather than a corporate pitch.
techniques: Use a faint graph-paper grid as a background texture.
Rotate a small tag label along one edge.
Draw the product (a car) as a simple line-art doodle.

vocabulary.definition: A faint grid pattern mimicking notebook paper.
A curved flowing band shape used for movement or connection.
